tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare up to 4 products side-by-side by id: each returns its full detail (offers, priceRange, ratings) plus curated technical attributes for a spec table. Unresolvable ids come back in `missingIds`. Read-only.

ids.description: Product ids to compare (max 4). A comma-separated string is also accepted.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: Fetch current offers plus daily price history for a numeric product id: each offer (store, priceCents, discountPct, stock, tracked click-out URL) and the cross-store min-per-day series over the window — useful to judge whether today's price is a good deal. Read-only.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch one product page by slug: name, brand, description, aggregate lowest price, 90-day min/max price, images, and EVERY external offer (store, numeric priceCents, list price, discountPct, stock status, and a tracked click-out URL). Includes offerCount, availability and a priceRange across offers. The slug comes from a search result `url`/`slug`. Read-only.

slug.description: Product slug from a search result URL.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Return this store's context for an agent: display name, canonical URL, kind (price-comparison), locale, a best-effort currency hint (authoritative currency is the per-offer currencyCode), a short description, and the catalog of available agent tools/endpoints. Call this first to orient before searching. Read-only.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the store's top-level departments/categories for navigation: name, product count, and the category page URL, ordered as shown in the menu. Use it to discover what the store sells before searching. Read-only.

tools.name: open_search_results
tools.description: Busca no catálogo de produtos da loja e abre a página de resultados

q.description: Termo de busca: produto, marca ou categoria

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search this price-comparison store's catalog by keyword. Returns lean product cards — id, name, brand, lowest price (as a display string AND numeric priceFromCents), currency, offer count, availability, rating, image, and the product page URL — ranked by the chosen sort. Use priceFromCents for numeric ranking; follow `url` or call get_product(slug) to drill in. Read-only.

sort.description: Ranking: top (relevance), menor (price asc), maior (price desc), desconto (biggest discount), vendidos (best-selling), nota (rating). Default: top.

tools.name: search_store_header
tools.description: Busca no catálogo da loja pelo cabeçalho e abre a página de resultados

q.description: Termo de busca: produto, marca ou categoria
